c01-carts.note: Chandyos on a ledge above the cliff road out of the Anchor, watching an oil cart go by.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: a port town's harbour seen from a sea-cliff, colonnaded customs house on the quay, a merchantman moored, Hellenistic Greece. Replace every placeholder shape with real rock, scrub, stone and tile. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no sun, no hard shadows, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its man, cart, mule and tablet exactly. Cut into the cliff face above the surf, two narrow single-file road shelves run one above the other, a few metres apart, each one cart wide, no passing places. On the lower shelf, leaving the town toward us, the board's cart of lashed oil amphorae drawn by the board's mule, a carter in a plain tunic at its head. On a ledge above the road the man (short dark hair, neat dark beard, undyed chiton, dark brown cloak) holds the open wax tablet, watching the cart pass. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.

c04-sash.note: The red-sash runner setting off from the Anchor onto the road, a loaded cart held back behind him.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: a paved street of a small port town of stone houses with terracotta roofs, leading out to a cliff road, Hellenistic Greece. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real rock, scrub, stone and roof tile. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no sun, no hard shadows, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its runner, cart and mule exactly. In the street, the runner (bareheaded, cropped hair, short undyed tunic, broad plain red sash from shoulder to hip) sets off at a run toward the road, carrying nothing. Behind him at a gateway, the board's cart of lashed oil amphorae stands loaded and waiting with the board's mule, a carter in a plain tunic holding its halter, not moving. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.
